$comment: RiskEngine.evaluateRiskSerialized evaluation order for UI catalog only. Pass/fail must come from RISK_GATE_EVALUATED / risk_gate_results — never from this file. sell_position_exists is recorded on SELL only; BUY assessments omit it. close_short_position_exists is recorded only when a BUY carries closePositionIntent=true (the operator-directed short-cover path, PipelineFlatten.ts) — never during normal autonomous BUY evaluation. buying_power_reservation is recorded on BUY only when reservedBuyNotional > 0 (informational, always passes — it documents the durable DB-derived reservation subtracted from the broker buying-power snapshot; a BUY with no outstanding reservation records 26 gates, one with a reservation records 27).
